snippet.title: Equi Ungula | Trailer
snippet.description:
Equi Ungula, where the boundary between faith and despair blurs in a surreal journey. You embody a disillusioned priest, once devoted to the enigmatic god Metcameque, now grappling with a crisis of faith. As night falls, a shadowy figure visits you, presenting a peculiar gift: an ant, unlike any other, capable of carrying you to the very edge of the world.

Embark on a peaceful journey through tranquil landscapes. Experience the calming atmosphere and gentle storytelling as you explore at your own pace, finding relaxation in every step.

 Restore your faith, or uncover truths that shatter your beliefs forever?
